_comment: Manuscript kit configuration. Edit this file, content.py and floats.py, then run build_manuscript.py and check_manuscript.py.

style.note: Caps, banned phrases and sentence targets live in style_limits.json (shared with prose_lint.py). Change an entry here by its label: a number sets a cap, null switches it off. List the manuscript's abbreviations in "abbreviations"; the checker fails any that is used before it is defined.
